title: Installment Payment Plans Terms: Endorsement Premium on Monthly Draft Notices
content:
**Endorsements added mid-term.** When an endorsement adds premium to an Owner Auto Policy term billed on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan or the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan of the **Installment Payment Plans**, the additional premium is billed through the term's draft notices as follows.

**What is spread.** The endorsement premium not yet billed is every additional premium transaction booked on the Owner Auto Policy term the plan bills, less the premium the plan's installment invoices have already billed beyond the scheduled installment premium, counted once for each of those invoices.

**How a draft notice bills it.** The installments unbilled at a notice are the plan's number of installments less the installment invoices already issued, the notice's own installment included.

| Endorsement premium not yet billed | Installments unbilled at the notice | Added to the notice's premium |
|---|---|---|
| more than 100.00 | two or more | an equal share: the endorsement premium not yet billed divided by the installments unbilled at the notice, rounded half up to the cent |
| more than 100.00 | only the notice's own installment | all of it |
| above zero and at most 100.00 | any number | all of it |
| zero or less | any number | no endorsement premium |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical amounts).** With 100.00 not yet billed and three installments unbilled, the notice adds the whole 100.00, since 100.00 is not more than 100.00. With 100.01 not yet billed and three unbilled, it adds 100.01 divided by 3, which is 33.336…, rounded to 33.34. With 450.00 not yet billed and the notice's installment the last one unbilled, it adds the whole 450.00.

The records read are the additional premium transactions booked on the Owner Auto Policy term and the premium amounts on the plan's own installment invoices.
